definitions.explanation: Taking something out of the place where it is kept, often said of documents, data or property that should stay inside.

definitions.gloss: out-of-pocket expense; paying the shortfall oneself
definitions.explanation: Covering part of a cost from one's own pocket when the money provided is not enough.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{出|だ}し⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧
⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{持|も}ち{出|だ}し⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The library's dictionaries cannot be taken out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社外|しゃがい}→社外：17992_shagai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{出|だ}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Taking personal data outside the company is strictly forbidden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交通費|こうつうひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{持|も}ち{出|だ}しだ。
examples.english: Travel costs are out of my own pocket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}り→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ず、{持|も}ち{出|だ}しになった。
examples.english: The budget fell short, so I had to make up the difference myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{数千円|すうせんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{出|だ}しになっている。
examples.english: In the end, the volunteer work costs me a few thousand yen a month out of my own pocket.

notes:
The noun of ⟦{持|も}ち{出|だ}す→持ち出す：06160_mochidasu⟧ (to take out). The emergency bag kept by the door for disasters is the ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧{持|も}ち{出|だ}し{袋|ぶくろ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {持|も}ち{出|だ}し⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: not to be taken out (a sign)
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧{持|も}ち{出|だ}し{袋|ぶくろ}: emergency grab bag
- {持|も}ち{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to end up paying out of one's own pocket

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→持ち込み：08293_mochikomi⟧: bringing (something) in; the opposite of sense 1
